title: Loom
description: An album cover woven from 96 threads each way, in twill, plain or satin. Drag across a row or down a column and its strip of the picture slides like a slot reel, the cloth ripples, and each thread plucks a pentatonic note as it springs home.
intent: One woven cover where pulling a single thread shears the whole cloth and plays it like a harp, with the next record weaving in row by row.
